intro: Welcome to the world of Pocket Johnians!
This map is real: it is drawn from OpenStreetMap, 4 metres to a tile.
You are standing in First Court, outside the Samuel Butler Room (I2).
Find the committee. Avoid tall grass. Never walk on the lawns, the porters are watching.
controls: Arrows/WASD move, Space/Z talk, X back
touchControls: D-pad moves, A talks, B goes back

moves.name: MENTION FUNDING
lines: A grant officer appears and leaves.

moves.name: ASK EXTENSION
lines: The deadline moves one day. Backwards.

moves.name: QUOTE BUTLER
lines: "Life is the art of drawing sufficient conclusions from insufficient premises."
Samuel Butler studied here 1854-58. It shows.
Erewhon is confused. So is the foe.

bag: You find a crumpled UPay receipt. You take 3 damage from looking at it.
You find a gown. You put it on. It is for BA Table, which is Tuesdays and Fridays.
You find a draft chapter. You put it back.
You find GBP1.50. That is exactly enough for Port & Sherry on Friday.
You find a punt pole. It does not fit in the bag. It never did.
sbr: You call the SBR committee. They are at BA Table. You feel slightly better.
The Welfare Officers send a biscuit. HP restored!
The SBR room has a pool table, a piano and a TV with a Wii. You think about them. HP restored!
The President promises to raise it with College. HP restored, eventually.
runFail: Can't escape! The Great Gate is locked after midnight.
Can't escape! You tried to cut across the grass.
Can't escape! Your supervisor has your location.
youFaint: POSTGRAD blacked out! You wake up in the SBR, slightly poorer.

encounters.name: PORTER
encounters.win: The porter returns to the Lodge to fill in a form about you.
encounters.flee: The porter writes down your name anyway.
encounters.fact: The Porters' Lodge is at the Great Gate, phone 01223 338671.

encounters.name: TOURIST
encounters.intro: It is blocking the entire passage for a photo.
taunts: Can I go inside? It says private.
encounters.win: The tourist leaves for the Bridge of Sighs. Everyone does.
encounters.fact: The Bridge of Sighs was built in 1831, designed by Henry Hutchinson.

encounters.name: GOOSE
encounters.intro: It has no natural predators on the Backs.
encounters.win: The goose waddles off. It will remember this.
encounters.flee: The goose wins. The goose always wins.
encounters.fact: The SBR is the graduate society of St John's, founded in 1960.

encounters.name: PUNT TOUT
encounters.intro: It has a laminated leaflet and no fear.
taunts: The tour goes past the Bridge of Sighs!
encounters.win: The tout finds a coach party instead.
encounters.flee: The tout lowers the price. You are already gone.
encounters.fact: College punts run from the Cripps Porters' Lodge, Easter Term to October, GBP8/hour.

encounters.name: SUPERVISOR
encounters.win: The supervisor goes on sabbatical. For a year.
encounters.flee: The supervisor sends a follow-up email.
encounters.fact: Your College tutor can help with problems with your supervisor.

portalBroken: A glowing portal hums next to the SBR's TV with a Wii.
The portal fizzles. Something blocky is still loading.
